featuresVerified: One-row footer with exactly Undo, Restore original defaults and one contextual Apply action; checked height at most 60 CSS pixels.
No health-policy selector or separate next-match button; contextual guidance is a hover tooltip and layout-free accessible description.
Unified battle apply preserves current resources/countdown and defers starting-only values; unified menu apply configures without starting a match.
Proportional health updates verified on both damaged crystals; a new match uses full health under the same applied maximums.

Regression coverage includes non-pausing F2, independent side stats/paid recruitment, safe-integer clamping, finite 501-troop spawning/cancellation, fullscreen and preset persistence across two launches.

numericPolicy.overflowingInput: clamps immediately to the field maximum
numericPolicy.integerArithmetic: safe saturated accounting in the opt-in custom runtime

speedSample.environment: Actual foreground maximized Windows portable EXE; short functional sample, not a sustained full-army performance benchmark
speedSample.limits: Machine, army size, window size and scheduling affect throughput; neither 20x nor 240 FPS is guaranteed. This is not a controlled comparison with prior release samples and does not establish a performance regression.

metadataExceptions: package.json with devDependencies, private and scripts removed

privacy.limits: Exact pinned upstream findings were reviewed, not suppressed. PE headers, resource section and overlay are not claimed byte-identical.

archive.scope: Local clean final ZIP extraction; runtime checks are recorded separately under portable. No complete remote redownload performed.

storage.excludes: Development dependencies, Git history and generated user data

renderPipeline.policy: UI-footer-only release: renderer, platform, main and view remain unchanged; graphics diagnosis was read-only.

unchanged.scopeLimit: Local original repository HEAD and worktree only; this audit does not query or change remotes.

remainingLimits: 20x and 240 FPS are targets, not guaranteed simulation or display throughput.

No artificial 100/500 spawn cap does not imply unlimited performance: quadratic combat scans and finite memory remain. Verification generated finite troops and cancelled a huge request, not MAX_SAFE_INTEGER live troops.
Extreme finite floating-point fields retain ordinary precision limits; values are not guaranteed useful gameplay.
This patch makes no rendering, image-quality or asset changes. The internal 640x480 canvas still scales to the window; direct original-PNG sampling is not native-window-resolution rendering.
No full HD art remaster or full Flash pixel parity is claimed. Windows executable is unsigned.
Bundle READMEs describe release state at the runtime source commit; later delivery documentation does not change or repackage the built code.
Archive was independently extracted locally; no full remote redownload has been performed.
